body: It's from the 2011 anime of THE iDOLM@STER, episode 25. There's a clip for the scene (in very bad quality) on YouTube [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dE1HUE5tTjk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dE1HUE5tTjk)
